description: This file contains extensions and view components related to channel settings, including UI sections for WhatsApp and other channels, as well as actions like login, logout, refresh, and configuration management within the ChannelsSettings context.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a grouped section with a title and content view, styling it as a GroupBox.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides action buttons for a channel, including logout options for WhatsApp and Telegram, and a refresh button.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Builds the UI section dedicated to WhatsApp linking, login, QR code display, and relinking.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Builds a UI section for generic channel configuration.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Provides UI for editing channel configuration, saving, and reloading drafts.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays configuration status messages if available.
